candidates.description: This feature vector activates on common Thai syllable prefixes, vowel markers, and recurring functional word fragments.
These tokens represent Thai quantifiers, determiners, and words denoting amounts, numbers, or distributions.
This vector represents the Thai consonant letter "ต" (to tao) appearing at the end of syllables or words as a final stop consonant.
These tokens represent subwords or characters frequently occurring within Thai words related to general concepts, grammar, or common vocabulary containing the Thai consonant 'ส' (So Sua).
This vector represents the Thai consonant letter 'ม' (Mo Ma) and its combinations with various Thai vowels and tone marks.
This feature vector is related to common Thai words and morphological components used in the Thai language.
This vector activates for common Thai noun prefixes and abstract nominal roots.
This vector activates strongly for Thai script characters, numerals, and unrelated noise tokens.
This vector represents a multilingual mixture of subword tokens spanning various scripts and semantic contexts without a single cohesive concept.
This feature vector represents Thai script characters and linguistic sub-tokens.
